parsed.note_claim: Lionel Messi was sent off with a red card for violent conduct in the 2021 Spanish Super Cup final against Athletic Bilbao, his first in a Barcelona shirt and third of his career.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Leo Messi was given a straight red card in extra-time in the Spanish Super Cup final for taking a swing at Athletic Club player Asier Villalibre
parsed.reason: The article confirms Messi received a straight red card for violent conduct in the Spanish Super Cup final against Athletic and states it was his first while playing for Barcelona.
